d:
In this video, I travel to one of the world’s most isolated and least visited countries, Eritrea, often called the North Korea of Africa. Getting here was not easy because traveling to Eritrea is very different from most countries, with a complicated visa process and limited internet access.
As soon as I arrived in Asmara, Eritrea’s capital, I was completely shocked. Instead of what I expected, I found a city that felt like stepping back in time, with vintage cars, beautiful old Italian architecture, classic cafes, and a completely unique atmosphere unlike anywhere else in Africa.
